payload.reason: The experiments focus specifically on the answerability of questions on the Q&A site Quora, analyzing linguistic and psycholinguistic factors that influence whether questions are answered or remain open.

claims.text: The study focuses on the answerability of questions on Quora, distinguishing between answered and open questions.
Linguistic and psycholinguistic aspects of question askers are key factors in predicting whether questions will be answered.
The research highlights the importance of question quality and visibility in determining answerability.
